x: In the Junior match the Cambridge boys won both sprint races with Dick Negus and G.
Held on the School ground in Wood Lane on Saturday, June 15th, and although we were not at full strength the Latymer boys were far too strong for our lads. G.
Training Schools 5 mile C.C. race recently. G.
The Hop, Step and Jump championship resulted in a win for P. Lowe (41 ft. 5 ins.), with G.

Now that Pete Lowe has recovered from his injury we look forward to having him in both these events. Steve Gibson can do really good performances in the Long Jump and Geoff. Barker in both events should make us stronger than for some years.
In the club handicap events the results were as under :— 100 yards.—1, G.
In the senior events we had Bob Taylor winning the mile and Bergvalds the javelin, and Dicky Bartlett and Geoff Barker gained a couple of third places in the sprint events.

Geoff Barker was second in the 100 yards Senior and Dicky Bartlett won a straight 220 yards Senior. Ian Badiali won the 880 yards in 2min. 0.8secs. with Don Maclean in third place, while Bill Lucas beat Len Adams in the Senior mile after a good race with Fieldsend of Mitcham A.C.
